About the job
We market over-the-counter health and personal care brands in Switzerland, Germany and Austria. During a parental leave we are looking for an Interim Marketing Director for eight months.

Responsibilities
• Lead the marketing team of twelve brand and digital managers
• Own brand plans, budgets and the 2027 media plan for our five core brands
• Drive two product launches in pharmacies and drugstores
• Steer creative, media and digital agencies
• Work with sales on activations with pharmacy chains and retail

Requirements
• 12+ years of brand marketing at a consumer goods or consumer health company, several years as marketing lead
• Experience with launches, media planning and agency management
• German and English fluent
• On site in Basel four days a week

Terms
• 8 months, start January 2027
• CHF 1,500 per day
